sloka: कामं राघव ते वाणी प्रमाणं धैर्यमाकृतिः ।सूचयन्ति परं तेजो भस्मच्छन्नमिवानलम् ॥४-११-८१॥।।
transliteration: kāmaṁ rāghava te vāṇī pramāṇaṁ dhairyamākṛtiḥ ।sūcayanti paraṁ tejo bhasmacchannamivānalam ॥4-11-81॥।।

translations.english: 'Rama your word and your courage indicate your supreme strength which is like fire covered with ashes.'
